source: Chapter 671: Beginning
target: Capitulum 671: Initium

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpres: CKtalon

source: Upon hearing Bunia’s words, Rhea was so surprised that she forgot her anger.
target: Verbīs Buniae audītīs, Rhea tam stupuit ut iram suam oblita esset.

source: It wasn’t the first time she had encountered such a situation.
target: Non primum talem casum experta fuit.

source: She was shocked that a man who had left a good impression on her would show such an expression and say such words.
target: Stupefacta est quod vir, qui in ea bonam impressionem reliquerat, talem vultum exhiberet atque talia verba diceret.

source: And this was when they weren’t even friends!
target: Et hoc, cum ne amicitia quidem haberent, accidit!

source: At that moment, Rhea wondered if she was still half-asleep.
target: At illo tempore Rhea quaesivit an adhuc semidormiens esset.

source: She also questioned whether Bunia had suffered a mental illness or succumbed to hysteria as the Dream Festival drew near.
target: Et percontabatur utrum Bunia infirmitāte mentis afflixa esset aut hysteriae succumbisset, dum Festa Somniorum appropinquaret.

source: Amidst Rhea’s bewilderment, Bunia’s smile intensified.
target: Inter perplexitatem Rhea, risus Buniae intensificatus est.

source: He extended his hands across the kitchen counter and attempted to grab Rhea’s chest.
target: Manus suas super mensam coquinaria extendit et conatus est pectus Rhea rapere.

source: Instinctively, Rhea leaned back, attempting to dodge.
target: Instinctū, Rhea retrorsum inclinavit, conans se evadere.

source: After failing to touch her, Bunia retracted his hands, propped himself up on the kitchen counter, and leaped up.
target: Postquam eam tangere non potuit, Bunia manus suas retraxit, super mensam coquinaria se sublevavit, et insiluit.

source: Amidst the clinking of coffee cups and glass jars, he lunged at Rhea, who was leaning back.
target: Inter tintinnationem poculorum caffēae et vasōrum vitrei, in Rhea impetum fecit, quae retrorsum inclināta erat.

source: This reaction, this choice, and this display of power caught Rhea off guard.
target: Haec reactio, haec electio, et haec ostentātiō potentiae Rhea inopināta reliquerunt.

source: She didn’t have time to remove the bow and arrow from her back.
target: Non tempus habuit arcum atque sagittam a tergo removere.

source: Her waist bent backward, and her right foot kicked up like the other end of a seesaw, sending the transformed Bunia cafe owner flying.
target: Lumbus eius retrorsum flectus est, et pes dēxter eius, ut alter extremus lūdī alternantis, in altum impellitur, transfigurātum Buniae cauponis in aethera proiecit.

source: Simultaneously, a thought flashed through Rhea’s mind.
target: Simul, quaedam cogitatio per mentem Rhea fulsit.

source: Has he truly lost his mind?
target: Num vere mentem amisit?

source: Crash. Bunia crashed to the side of the kitchen counter.
target: Fragor. Bunia ad latus mensae coquinariae corruit.

source: Rhea exerted strength in her back and stood up straight again.
target: Rhea viribus in tergo ūsa est et iterum recta stetit.

source: Then, she took off her hunting bow, nocked an arrow, and aimed at Bunia, who had just stood up.
target: Tum arcum venatorium abstulit, sagittam immovit, et in Buniam, quī modo surrexit, destinavit.

source: A look of fear crossed Bunia’s face.
target: Vultus timōris in facie Buniae apparuit.

source: He froze for a moment before pleading, “Don’t—don’t kill me!
target: Statim immobilis factus est, deinde obsecrāns dīxit: “Nōli, nōli me occidere!”

source: “I suddenly lost control just now!”
target: “Mōdo subito imperium amīsī!”

source: Looking at Bunia’s pleading and fearful face, Rhea found him both familiar and unfamiliar.
target: Aspiciens vultum obsecrāntem et timōre afflictum Buniae, Rhea eum tam nōtum quam ignōtum invenit.

source: The arrow on the bowstring was drawn back, but she didn’t release it.
target: Sagitta in funī arcūs trahīta erat, sed eam nōn dimīsit.

source: Entering the streets of Tizamo Town from the primitive forest, Lumian observed the illuminated houses on both sides and scoffed.
target: Ex silva primitiva in vīs oppidi Tizamo ingrediēns, Lumian domōs utrīnque illuminātās observāvit et irridēns susurrāvit.

source: “Is this supposed to be terrifying and bizarre?”
target: “Num hoc esse dēbet terrībile et insōlitum?”

source: This wasn’t the first time he had encountered such a scene.
target: Non primum talem scenam expertus est.

source: In Fourth Epoch Trier, he had witnessed a similar occurrence.
target: In Trei Aetāte Quārtā, similem casum perspexit.

source: Not only had the dark town regained its lights, but the entire Fourth Epoch Trier had transitioned from silence to noisiness, returning to life.
target: Non sōlum oppidum obscūrum lūmina sua restituerat, sed totus Trei Aetāte Quārtā a silentiō in sonitum conversus erat, vītam referēns.

source: Faced with this abnormality, Lumian was undoubtedly surprised and highly vigilant.
target: Ob hanc inordinātam condītiōnem, Lumian indubitābiliter obstupuit et māxime vigilantiam habuit.

source: However, he wasn’t overwhelmed by intense emotions.
target: Attamen, affectibus intensīs nōn dominātus est.

source: On the surface, he observed his surroundings leisurely.
target: Ille circumstantiās sua trānquillē observāvit.

source: He realized that Reaza and Maslow had vanished.
target: Animādvērit Reaza et Maslow evanuisse.

source: The two patrol team members who should have been following him were gone.
target: Duo membra turmae praesidiāriā, quae eum sequi debuerant, evanuerant.

source: Since it can silently make two Beyonders disappear right under my nose, it can definitely make me vanish just like that…
target: Cum duo Beyonders silentiō sub meō nasō evanescere possint, certē et me ita evanescere poterit…

source: In other words, 1 must have been affected.
target: Aliter dīcendum est: 1 affectus esse debuit.

source: There’s a high chance that the trance was an external manifestation…
target: Magnā probabilitās est ut illa transe externā manifestātiō fuisset…

source: From a mysticism perspective, the town, which had already fallen into a deep slumber, relighting without any significant turn of events, signifies that I’m in another scene, one that is originally related but different…
target: Ex prōspectū mysticō, oppidum, quod iam in profundō somnō lapsum erat, sine aliquā notā mutātiōne rursum lūcēbat, significat mē in aliā scēnā esse, quae origināriē cognāta sed diversa est…

source: Could it be that I’ve been forced into a dream?
target: Num fortasse coāctus sum in somnium ingredī?

source: Has the Dream Festival officially begun?
target: Num Festum Somniorum officiōsē incepit?

source: 1 didn’t sleep in Hisoka’s house.
target: 1 in domō Hisoka nōn dormīvit.

source: Why am 1 still awake?
target: Cur 1 adhūc vigil sum?

source: Combined with the ongoing investigation, Lumian quickly deduced the current situation.
target: Cum investigātiōne in processū, Lumian celeriter rem prēsēns intellexit.

source: At that moment, he spotted a figure emerging from a glass window diagonally ahead, surrounded by wooden planks and weeds.
target: In illo tempore, animādvērit figuram ex fēnēstrā vitrea diagonaliter emergentem, circumdatam tabulīs līneiīs et herbīs.

source: It was a local man in his early forties, with dark brown skin, brown eyes, black hair, and thick lips.
target: Fuit vir loci, in prīmā quadrāgintā annōrum incipiēns, cum cute fuscā, oculīs fuscīs, capillīs nigrīs, et labrīs crassīs.

source: Lumian had seen him before.
target: Lumian eum anteā vīdit.

source: He was a hunting guide, responsible for leading gentlemen and ladies from Port Pylos and other places into the forest for hunting.
target: Erat dux venātiōnis, quī ducebat domīnōs et domināe ex Portū Pylos atque aliīs locīs in silvam ad venandum.

source: Lumian’s impression of him was that he always wore a fawning smile.
target: Impressiō Lumianī de eo fuit, quod semper rīsum adulatorium gerebat.

source: No matter what others said, he would respond with a string of affirmatives.
target: Quidquid alīī dixerunt, ille respondit seriem affirmationum.

source: He never showed anger, even when punished by the gentlemen and ladies he guided.
target: Numquam īram ostendit, etiam cum a domīnōs atque domināe, quōs ducebat, castigārētur.

source: Upon seeing Lumian, the hunting guide’s lips curled into a cruel smile.
target: Cum Lumianum vīdit, labia ducis venātiōnis in rīsū crudeliter contracta sunt.

source: He pushed open the window and raised his other hand, revealing a double-barreled shotgun.
target: Fēnēstram aperuit et alteram manū levāt, ostendēns sclopetum duplicem.

source: “Die, you Northern Continent dog!”
target: “Morere, canis Continentis Septentrionalis!”

source: As the hunting guide cursed, he aimed his double-barreled shotgun at Lumian and pulled the trigger without hesitation.
target: Dum dux venātiōnis maledicebat, sclopetum duplicem in Lumian intenxit et sine mora ictum dedit.

source: Hang!
target: Heu!

source: A massive amount of lead spread out in a cone, enveloping the corresponding area.
target: Magna multitūdō plumbī in conō diffusā est, circumveniēns regionem pertinēntem.

source: As the hunting guide took aim, Lumian sidestepped and rolled to the other side of the street.
target: Dum dux venātiōnis intenxit, Lumian sē declināvit et in alterum latus vīae volvit.

source: What greeted his eyes were the previously quiet cows, sheep, and horses.
target: Id quod occulī eius recipiēbantur, erant vaccae, oves, et equi, quī anteā quietī erant.

source: At that moment, the eyes of these animals seemed to turn bloodshot.
target: At illo tempore, oculī horum animālium rubefactī videbantur.

source: Supporting himself with one hand, Lumian leaped up.
target: Sustinēns sē ūnā manū, Lumian insiluit.

source: Amidst the high-pitched mooing and the hunting guide’s aim, he leaped to the middle of the stairs leading to the second floor.
target: Inter altum mugitum et ducis venātiōnis intentiōnem, in mediam scalae ad secundum planum insiluit.

source: “Ah!” A scream suddenly pierced the air, then stopped abruptly.
target: “Ah!” Clāmur subito in āerem percussit, deinde repentinō cessāvit.

source: The door on the second floor swung open, and Lumian was confronted by a young man drenched in bright red blood.
target: Iānuā in secundo planō aperta est, et Lumian obversātur iuvenī, nitidō rubrō sanguine perfusō.

source: He held a massive axe dripping with the crimson liquid, and behind him lay the mangled corpse of an old man in his fifties, the wound carved deep into his chest.
target: Tenēbat magnam securim, sanguine rubrō stillantē, et post eum iacebat lacerātum cadāver senis quinquāgenārī, cuius vulnus in pectore altē incisum erat.

source: Lumian, who had been wandering Tizamo Town for days, was no stranger to these two individuals.
target: Lumian, quī per diēs oppidum Tizamo vagātus erat, his duōbus hominibus nōn ignōtus erat.

source: Lying on the ground, his eyes wide open, was the leathersmith of Tizamo Town.
target: Iacens in terra, oculīs patefactīs, erat cuīrārius oppidī Tizamo.

source: He would purchase the hides of wild beasts brought back by gentlemen, ladies, and town hunters who didn’t want to handle them themselves, processing them and selling the finished products.
target: Ipse emēbat pellēs ferārum, quās domīnōs, domināe, et venātōrēs oppidī, quī eas ipsī tractare nōluerant, reportābant; ea conficiēns et operā perfecta vendēns.

source: The axe-wielding figure was his eldest son, who had studied nitrification, tanning, and other leather production techniques from him.
target: Figura, securim ferēns, erat prīmogenitus eius, quī ab eo nitrificātiōnem, curtitiōnem, et alias technicās coriariae producendī didicerat.

source: He was known as an obedient young man, and his father wasn’t an old-fashioned leathersmith who resorted to physical or verbal violence.
target: Nōtus erat ut iuvenis oboediēns, et pater eius nōn erat cuīrārius antiquus, quī ad vim corporālem aut verba flagitiāria adhiberet.

source: This was a characteristic of the people of Tizamo.
target: Hoc erat proprium īnde ingenium populi Tizamo.

source: They were docile, calm, and devoid of intense emotions.
target: Erant mītī, trānquillī, et affectibus intensīs carentēs.

source: And now, it appeared that the leathersmith’s eldest son had just cleaved his father to death.
target: Et nunc, apparuit fīlius prīmogenitus cuīrāriī patrem suum modo caedere fēcisse.

source: Upon seeing Lumian, the lad’s eyes overflowed with a bloodthirsty smile.
target: Cum Lumianum vīdit, oculī pueri sanguinis cupiditāte plēni, rīsus avidus ostendērunt.

source: With a shout, he swung his axe at Lumian.
target: Cum clāmōre, securim suam in Lumian iaculātus est.

source: On the other side, the hunting guide began reloading his double-barreled shotgun with new lead rounds.
target: In alterā parte, dux venātiōnis sclopetum duplicem novīs globīs plumbī reimplēvit.

source: Lumian’s body suddenly turned ethereal, merging with his shadow and vanishing into the darkness beside the steps.
target: Corpus Lumianī subito aetereum factum est, cum umbrā suā commiscēns, et in tenebrīs iuxta grādus evanuit.

source: Shadow Transformation!
target: Transformatio Umbrārum!

source: After using this ability to sneak towards the police headquarters for a few seconds, Lumian suddenly heard someone pleading for mercy in fear.
target: Postquam hanc facultātem ad prāetōrium vigilum paulīs secundīs insidiātus est, Lumian repentinē audīvīt aliquem, metuēns, misericordiam obsecrantem.

source: He left the shadows and transformed back into a human.
target: Ex umbrīs discessit et in hominem iterum sē transformāvit.

source: He saw Rhea aiming an arrow at the cafe owner, Bunia, but she didn’t release it.
target: Vīdit Rhea sagittam in dominum cauponae, Buniam, intendentem, sed eam nōn dimīsit.

source: At that moment, a colossal anaconda, as thick as a barrel, emerged from the multi-layered hay at the top of the opposite house, hanging upside down.
target: At illo tempore, ingens anaconda, tam crassā ut dolium, ex pluribus strātīs fāenī in summō domūs oppositae emergit, inversā pendentis.

source: It widened its cold eyes and foul-smelling mouth, the patterns on its scales seeming to expand and writhe.
target: Oculōs suōs frigīdōs dilatāvit et os foetidum patefecit, et formae in squāmīs eius expandī et contorquērī videbantur.

source: This time, Lumian didn’t dodge.
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian nōn evāsit.

source: Facing the colossal boa attempting to devour him, his eyes darkened as he swung his fist upward.
target: Adversus ingentem boam, quā eum devorāre conābātur, oculī eius obscurī factī sunt, dum pugnum suum sursum iactābat.

source: In an instant, blazing white flames ignited from his fist, enveloping his entire forearm.
target: In momento, flammae albae ardentēs ex pugnō eius exārserunt, totum bracchium eius involvēns.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Lumian’s fist smashed into the colossal boa’s gaping maw, tearing through the blood-colored flesh and delivering a devastating uppercut to its upper jaw.
target: Pugnō Lumianī os ingentis boae, quod late patebat, percussit, lānīāns carnem rubram, atque ictum superiōrem in maxillam eius perferēns.

source: Before it could devour its human prey, the colossal boa’s cold eyes lost their luster.
target: Antequam prae-dam humanam devorāretur, oculī frigīdī ingentis boae splendōrem amisērunt.

source: Its massive body plummeted due to inertia, but Lumian easily sidestepped the falling serpent and retracted his fist.
target: Corpus eius ingens, inertiae causā, corruit; sed Lumian facile serpentem cadentem evitāvit et pugnum suum retrāxit.

source: Clang!
target: Clang!

source: The colossal boa crashed to the ground, its slippery scaled body engulfed in blazing white flames.
target: Ingens boa in terram corruit, corpus eius squamōsum lībridum in flammīs albis ardentibus inclusum est.

source: Weakness Investigation!
target: Investigātiō Debilitatum!

source: Lumian approached Rhea, noticing that the patrol team member was also regarding him with a vigilant and puzzled expression.
target: Lumian ad Rhea accessit, animādvērēns membrum turmae praesidiāriāque eum cum vigilantia et vultū perplexō intuentem.

source: He didn’t attack immediately.
target: Nōn statim oppugnāvit.

source: She… Lumian’s heart stirred as a smile played across his lips.
target: Illa… cor Lumianī concitātus est, dum rīsus per labia eius lūderet.

source: “Looks like you’re still lucid.”
target: “Vidētur tē adhūc lucida esse.”

source: Wary of Bunia, Rhea observed Louis Berry for a moment, hesitating before speaking.
target: Cauta dē Bunia, Rhea per momentum Louis Berry observāvit, haesitāns antequam loquī coepit.

source: “Lucid, you say?”
target: “Lucida, dīcis?”

source: “Yes.” Lumian pointed at Bunia, who was glaring at him with undisguised hatred. “Did he attempt to attack you or even rape you?”
target: “Ita.” Lumian, ad Buniam intendēns, quī eum odōre manifestō detrectābat, addidit: “Tentāvitne tē oppugnāre aut etiam violāre?”

source: “Yes.” Rhea didn’t ask how he knew. Instead, she inquired, “What’s going on?”
target: “Ita.” Rhea nōn rogāvit quomōde scīret, sed interrogāvit: “Quid accidit?”

source: Padre Cali was already standing at the cathedral’s entrance.
target: Padre Cali iam ad introitum catherdralis stabat.

source: However, he was no longer clad in the Eternal Blazing Sun Church clergyman’s robe with its white and golden threads.
target: Attamen, nōn iam indūtus erat veste clergōnicā Ecclesiā Solis Aeternī Flammae, filīs albīs et aurēīs ornātā.

source: Instead, he had donned a dark and intricately designed robe.
target: Pro eō, indūtus erat veste obscūrā et subtiliter confectā.

source: The padre, with his dark-brown skin, sunken eyes, and stiff facial features, gazed out at the empty square before his eyes settled on the newly arrived Lumian and Rhea.
target: Padre, cum cute fuscā, oculīs demissīs, et lineāmentīs rigīdīs, in plateam vacuām intuēns, animādvērit nuper adventōs Lumian et Rhea.

source: He held the Bible aloft and shouted with a frenzied expression, “1 hereby declare the official commencement of the Dream Festival!
target: Biblicam sublātam tenēns et vultū exagitātō clamāvit: “Hic dēclārō initium Festī Somniorum officiōsum!”

source: “During the Dream Festival, there are no taboos or restrictions. You are free to do as you wish, including harming and killing.
target: “Durante Festō Somniorum, nullae sunt prōhibitiōnēs aut restrictionēs; libērē agere potētis, etiam si nocere et occīdere id vēlitis.

source: “Revel in it and unleash all your emotions and desires, everyone!”
target: “Exsultāte in ēo et omnem vestram affectūs ac dēsīderia effundite, omnēs!”
